1.title: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
1.summary: The US President said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

2.title: Top Lawmakers Agree A.I.’s Risks Are Rising but Say They Have No Quick Fix
2.summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson warned on Sunday of competitive risks from China, and Hakeem Jeffries, the minority leader, said Congress should start regulatory talks this week.

3.title: US congressman swims to safety after his plane is forced to land on a lake
3.summary: The small plane carrying Rep Tom Tiffany had a mechanical issue that forced the pilot to make an emergency landing on a Wisconsin lake.

5.title: Trump doubles down on united Ireland comments on day two of visit
5.summary: The US president was speaking at the Irish Open on Sunday and said "many people agree" with his comments.

6.title: Iran Expected to Meet With Gulf Arab States as Mideast Conflict Widens
6.summary: Talks are expected tomorrow, officials said, as a ship was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian allies in Yemen said they had launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia.
